newsitem.title: FRANCE: French surveys disagree on early election.
newsitem.headline: French surveys disagree on early election.

text.p: An opinion poll released on Wednesday said a majority of French people favour calling an early election, contradicting another survey published five days earlier.
The CSA poll for the weekly L'Evenement du Jeudi said 41 percent of 1,003 people questioned favoured dissolving the National Assembly for early elections and 35 percent opposed it.

Highlighting voters' perplexity amid rumours that President Jacques Chirac may bring the election forward from March next year, an Ipsos poll last weekend said two-thirds of the French opposed it, to 23 percent who favoured it.
